info.title: ReBuild Bangladesh REST API
info.description: Cookie sessions issued by Better Auth at /api/auth. All cookie-authenticated mutations require the configured Origin. Standard envelope: {data,requestId}; errors: {error:{code,message,fields?},requestId}. Monetary fields use integer paisa; quantity uses whole sale increments. Read APIs never expose exact pickup details except to order participants after acceptance. Authentication API is documented separately in docs/api.md.
